steps.input:
cat > programs/task-9fc5be4b.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    """Recolor every complete uniform row or column to 2."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1]
    for r in rows:
        for j in range(w):
            out[r][j] = 2
    for j in cols:
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][j] = 2
    return out
PY
